name: flutter
label: Flutter / Dart
_comment: The stack descriptor. Single source of truth for everything the kit needs to know
about a toolchain: install.sh, the /init skill and the guard's auto-detection all
read this file instead of carrying a per-stack branch of their own.
markers          files whose presence identifies the stack in an unknown repo.
protected_roots  production code + tests. Written verbatim into .doe/doe.config.json,
which is what the guard actually reads on an installed project.
conventions      true when the stack ships conventions.example.json.
